meta.name: copywriting-manager-sequence
meta.description: Writes a 3-email outbound sequence targeting Manager-level buyers (Sales Manager, Marketing Manager, RevOps Manager, Team Lead, Operations Manager, etc.). Use this skill whenever the user wants to write cold emails for a Manager, says "write me a sequence for a Sales Manager", "draft emails targeting managers", or provides a manager persona and asks for outreach copy. Always produces a complete 3-email campaign following strict copywriting rules, calibrated for operational, team-focused manager messaging.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 撰写面向经理级买家的3封冷邮件序列
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要针对销售经理等中层决策者撰写自动化邮件序列。
copy.tagline_en: Write a 3-email outbound sequence targeting Manager-level buyers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to write automated email sequences targeting middle-level decision makers like Sales Managers.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会为经理级买家（如销售经理、运营经理）撰写3封冷邮件序列。它会先收集你的目标人物与公司信息，再写出贴合经理日常痛点的邮件，严格遵循50-100词、两字主题、不提产品功能等规则。
howto.when: 当你请求为某类经理写冷邮件序列时触发，比如说‘帮我写一个针对销售经理的序列’或提供经理人物画像要求外联文案。

say.text: 帮我写一个针对销售经理的3封Cold Email序列。
say.note: Claude会收集上下文后生成邮件。

say.text: 给我写一个给运营经理的外联邮件序列。
say.note: Claude会调用该技能生成3封邮件。

say.text: 为市场经理草拟一个邮件序列，团队5人。
say.note: Claude会按经理类型和团队规模定制内容。
